title: The 5 biggest cybersecurity threats of 2026 that nobody is prepared for

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Did you know AI-driven phishing attacks will hit 80% of companies by 2026?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Cybercriminals are using AI to mimic CEOs and trick employees into sending money.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It’s when AI generates ultra-realistic fake emails, videos, and voice calls.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: These attacks use deepfake tech that can fool even the most trained eyes.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Small businesses and mid-sized firms are hit hardest—no budget for advanced AI defense.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key takeaway? AI isn’t just a tool—it’s now a weapon in the hands of hackers.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Want to know how to protect yourself? Tap for the full breakdown.
